description:
[h2]A quiet, rain-soaked mountain valley somewhere in East Asia. Thick fog settles at the base of the cliffs, slowly swallowing the curved roof of an old temple below. No sun — just grey skies, damp moss, and the soft sound of rain.[/h2]

[h1][b]Features:[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Animated fog[/b]
[*][b]Rain with ambient sound (can be muted in audio settings)[/b]
[*][b]Falling leaves and an occasional birds crossing the scene[/b]
[*][b]Rare lightning flashes across the sky with thunder sound[/b]
[*][b]Minimalist digital clock with a frosted-glass effect, inspired by the iOS lock screen[/b]
[/list]

Supports 16:9, 16:10, and 21:9 displays (including 4K)
Performance: ~145 MB VRAM, smooth FPS, low–medium GPU usage
